Job Title: Change Management Lead
  • Job Location: Hyderabad
About Sanofi
We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From RD to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.
Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of RD and consequent new launches in our history. The Go-to-Market Capabilities Team was organized to consolidate business operations efforts globally across all business units with an eye to create efficiencies that fund our pipeline and prepare us to drive multiple new product launches as we strive to materialize the miracles of science to improve people''s lives.
About the Job
The Change Management Lead - Manager role is a part of the Go-to-Market Capabilities (GTMC), Customer Facing Capabilities (CFC), CRM Enablers team. The GTMC organization drives best-in-class capabilities and brings value and excellence in commercial operations. The GTMC organization is a key part of the modernization of Sanofi and allows all business operations efforts to be focused on Sanofi "Take the Lead" priorities across products, markets, and pipelines. It accomplishes these goals through realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up the decision-making process.
This role serves as the technical authority for change management and user enablement across OneCRM US, leading the strategy for adoption, training architecture, and knowledge management. This leader designs and implements scalable change management solutions that support multi-brand, multi-market launch requirements, ensuring enterprise-wide CRM adoption and capability development.
This position will work closely with CRM Enablers Team members in the US, US-based stakeholders, Hyderabad HUB resources, contracted system enhancement resources, Sr. Field Management, the Workday Team, select vendors (i.e. Hibbert), other GTMC pillars, Veeva, and Sanofi Digital to lead the end-to-end design and execution of change management, training, and knowledge management strategies across the OneCRM US ecosystem.
Main Responsibilities
  • Lead the strategic vision and roadmap for change management, training architecture, and knowledge management across OneCRM US, ensuring alignment with enterprise CRM standards and business priorities
  • Influence enterprise-wide change management strategy and adoption approaches, partnering with Platform, Operations, and Business teams to shape change strategies for major CRM initiatives
  • Design and implement scalable change management and enablement solutions, ensuring timely and effective delivery of materials to end users
  • Architect end-to-end training and knowledge management frameworks - including SharePoint-based knowledge hubs, quick reference guide libraries, and process SOPs - that scale with organizational growth
  • Serve as the technical authority on change management methodologies, adult learning principles, and enablement best practices across the OneCRM US organization
  • Drive technical decisions on training platforms, content management systems, and knowledge delivery channels, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and fit for purpose
  • Lead and mentor the change management team in instructional design, technical writing, and change leadership best practices, providing technical guidance and knowledge transfer that elevates team capability
  • Drive capability building across the broader CRM community through train-the-trainer programs, structured onboarding, and ongoing enablement initiatives
  • Influence stakeholder adoption strategies and communication plans across senior leadership and field teams, ensuring alignment and engagement throughout the change lifecycle
  • Lead transformation of change management processes, driving adoption of modern enablement approaches and establishing measurement frameworks to track adoption, effectiveness, and continuous improvement
  • Investigate and remediate escalated inquiries, applying technical expertise to resolve complex issues and prevent recurrence through systemic process improvements
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across partner GTMC US teams, ensuring change management strategies are integrated with platform, operations, and business initiatives
About our Team
The CRM Enablers Team is a part of the GTMC organization in the US. The CRM Enablers Team strives to support our business customer facing teams by delivering innovative CRM capabilities that are timely, reliable, accurate, and constantly improving. We focus on our customers both brand teams and customer facing teams to adapt our CRM platform and operational systems to meet their needs. Our efforts to streamline and maintain OneCRM US bring value and impact to the organization by reducing the manual workload on our customer facing teams, by providing accurate activity data back to reporting systems, and acting as the nexus of data flow to and from Sanofi data systems.
About the Candidate This candidate has a demonstrated track record of leading change management teams, influencing enterprise adoption strategies, and designing scalable enablement solutions across multiple business units and product launches. They bring deep expertise in change management methodologies, instructional design, and adult learning principles, combined with strong CRM platform knowledge. This leader has experience architecting training frameworks, driving process transformation, and building organizational capability at scale. They are skilled at influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex matrix environments, and translating technical platform changes into clear, compelling enablement strategies. Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills are essential, with the ability to engage and align diverse audiences across geographies and functions.
Experience
  • 7+ years of progressive change management and CRM enablement experience with demonstrated leadership.
  • 7+ years of experience in Biotechnology or Pharmaceuticals.
  • Proven track record of leading technical teams and driving strategic change initiatives across enterprise-scale programs.
  • Experience in solution architecture for training platforms, knowledge management systems, and content delivery channels.
  • Advanced skills in managing senior stakeholder relationships across business units and multiple launch projects.
  • Experience influencing enterprise-wide adoption strategies and change management approaches.
  • Strong knowledge and experience with Veeva CRM and Agile processes.
  • A keen eye for improvement opportunities and the demonstrated ability to deliver on these opportunities.
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to explain not only the requirements and the "ask", but also the "why" with credibility.
  • Motivated, energetic, and a respected contributor who engages and elevates others.
  • Ability to change behaviors to evolve to the company''s strategies and initiatives.
  • Experience working and thriving in a matrix environment.
  • Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills, with demonstrated ability to produce high-quality enablement and training content
Education: Bachelor''s degree from an accredited four-year college or university (Project Management Masters or MBA preferred).
Languages: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written)

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether its through a promotion or lateral move, at home orinternationally
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact

title: Senior Associate - Clinical Pharmacology
tagsAndSkills: adam,chemistry,biology,data analysis,quality control,drug development,project team,microsoft office
jobDescription:
The department of Clinical Pharmacology, Modeling and Simulation (CPMS) within Amgen is dedicated to the development of novel, effective, and safe medicines. We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Associate to join the CPMS group.
The successful candidate will contribute to Amgens multimodality development portfolio by conducting formal clinical pharmacology data analyses, summarizing pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) data and results in clinical study report documents, performing quality control, reviewing PK/PD datasets, and adhering to applicable regulatory guidance (ie, good clinical practices [GCP]). In addition, the successful candidate will possess good written and oral communication skills, the ability to work well in teams, and will demonstrate technical aptitude and a strong work ethic. The individual will also be responsible for review and compliance with all applicable SOPs, business practices and company policies.
The primary core responsibilities of the Senior Associate will include:
  • Execution of formal PK/PD data analysis and report writing for clinical studies with a strong emphasis on quality and meeting timelines
  • Perform quality control of analyses and outputs (ie, tables, figures, listings, and reports) to ensure accuracy and consistency in accordance with standard processes
  • Review and create standardized datasets supporting clinical pharmacology analyses
  • Work closely with CPMS data analysts and other team members, effectively communicate with project team representatives and actively participate/collaborate cross functionally
Basic Qualifications
Bachelors degree with 5-9 Years of total experience and 3 years of relevant experience in clinical pharmacology data analysis with an emphasis on non-compartmental analysis
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Pharmacy preferred, but can also be in related fields such as biology, chemistry, or biochemistry.
  • Following skills are required:
    • good understanding of clinical pharmacology and pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic concepts
    • experience in conducting non-compartmental analysis
    • experience working with clinical pharmacology datasets and report writing
    • experience in working with Phoenix analysis software and with standardized analysis datasets (ADaM)
  • Familiar with the drug development process, regulatory guidelines (including Good Clinical Practices), analysis methodology, and clinical pharmacology studies
  • Skilled in using Microsoft Office software (ie, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Able to work under tight deadlines
  • Strong analytical, writing, communication, organization, and teamwork skills

title: Software Development Engineer- Test II
jobDescription:
ABOUT AMGEN
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the worlds toughest diseases and make peoples lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond whats known today.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Role Description:
The Software Development Engineer-Test II position offers a unique opportunity to join a fun, innovative engineering team within the AI Data Science (AID) - organization. We are the Applied AI team (AI Studio). AI Studio is Amgens enterprise engine for turning high-value business challenges into scalable AI products. We partner with key business partners across the company to identify the right opportunities, shape them into actionable use cases, and design, build, and launch AI products responsibly. Our work spans the full lifecyclefrom early discovery and rapid prototyping to production deployment, reuse across the enterprise, and measurable business impact.
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of enterprise automation solutions with a strong focus on computer systems validation including test automation, test planning, execution, and defect management. You will work closely with product owners, developers, and QA teams to validate systems against business and regulatory requirements. This role is critical in ensuring that automation solutions meet performance, security, and compliance expectations across the development lifecycle, especially in GxP-regulated environments.
Roles Responsibilities:
  • Build and promote test engineering practices, standards, and automation frameworks while fostering a strong quality-first and test automation culture.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated and manual test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements for enterprise, AI-driven, and workflow automation solutions.
  • Perform testing activities in compliance with GxP and Computer System Validation (CSV) regulations, ensuring proper documentation, execution, traceability, and audit readiness.
  • Create and maintain Requirement Traceability Matrices (RTMs) to ensure complete test coverage and regulatory compliance.
  • Log, track, and manage defects using tools such as HP ALM, Azure DevOps, or Jira, ensuring clear documentation and end-to-end traceability.
  • Execute and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Systems Integration Testing (SIT), Operational Qualification (OQ), regression testing, and validation activities across regulated environments.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, and validation teams to ensure defects are resolved effectively and quality standards are consistently achieved.
  • Develop and maintain automation test scripts using tools such as UiPath Test Suite, Selenium, Postman, or similar technologies to improve test efficiency and coverage.
  • Maintain comprehensive testing documentation, evidence packages, and validation artifacts to support compliance, inspections, and audit readiness.
  • Perform end-to-end testing of LLM-powered, Agentic AI, and Custom GPT solutions, including prompt validation, response accuracy, grounding verification, hallucination detection, and Responsible AI compliance assessments.
  • Validate AI-generated artifacts, automated workflows, and intelligent automation outputs to ensure reliability, consistency, data integrity, explainability, and compliance within GxP-regulated processes.
  • Implement risk-based testing strategies for AI and automation platforms, focusing on quality, security, compliance, traceability, model performance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Understanding end-to-end AI/ML lifecycle.
Basic Qualifications
  • Any degree and 5 to 9 years of Life Science/Biotechnology/Pharmacology/Information Systems experience
Functional Skills:
Must-Have Skills:
  • Advanced experience in designing and executing both manual and automated test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Advanced knowledge of test lifecycle documentation including test plans, RTMs, OQ protocols, and summary reports
  • Hands-on experience with UiPath Test Suite, Selenium, Postman, or similar tools.
  • Advanced experience in validated (GxP) environments and with CSV practices
  • Proficient in creating test lifecycle documentation (RTMs, OQ protocols, test plans, reports) and supporting end-to-end testing within regulated GxP and CSV-compliant computer systems, ensuring adherence to validation, audit, and documentation standards
Good-to-Have Skills:
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain test automation scripts using data-driven, keyword-driven, or hybrid frameworks, enabling reusable, scalable, and maintainable test coverage across systems.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and continuous testing practices
  • Strong test design and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools for integrating testing into DevOps pipelines.
  • Experience collaborating with Cross-Functional teams, particularly within healthcare or pharmaceutical environments.
  • Experience in handling product features for PI planning and developing product roadmaps and user journeys
  • Able to communicate complex subject matters in business terms
  • Familiarity with GxP, CFR 21 Part 11 and systems validation
Professional Certifications
  • ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Level Certification (Optional but valuable)
  • SAFe Agile Tester Certification (Optional but valuable)
  • Lean Six Sigma certification (Optional but valuable)
  • PMP Certification (Optional but valuable)
Soft Skills:
  • Excellent critical-thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Demonstrated awareness of how to function in a team setting
  • Demonstrated awareness of presentation skills

title: Salesforce Program Manager
tagsAndSkills: Scrum, CSM, Agile, SAFe, PMP, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud
jobDescription:
As a Salesforce Project Manager (Individual contributor), you will lead & own the end-to-end delivery of global, outcomes-based Salesforce implementations using Agile methodologies and modern, AI-enabled delivery practices. You will be accountable for delivery excellence, financial performance, governance, and stakeholder alignment, operating with a strong business-owner & customer-first mindset. This role requires strategic thinking, executive presence, and hands-on delivery leadership to manage complex Salesforce programs, protect project margins, and scale delivery impact across the organisation.

What We Expect
• End-to-End Salesforce Delivery & Financial Ownership: Own the complete Salesforce delivery lifecycle, managing scope, timelines, risks, resourcing, and dependencies while ensuring high-quality outcomes and protecting Sold vs. Delivered margins.
• Agile Delivery Leadership: Lead Agile delivery using frameworks such as Scrum and SAFe, driving sprint execution, backlog prioritisation, delivery predictability, and high-performing cross-functional Salesforce teams.
• Program Planning & Roadmap Management: Develop and manage integrated project plans and delivery roadmaps, ensuring transparent progress reporting, risk visibility, and dependency management across the engagement lifecycle.
• Drive Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks from a delivery standpoint, establishing clear project tracking milestones for predictive and generative AI workstreams while managing downstream environment and data dependencies
• Stakeholder & Executive Management: Drive stakeholder alignment through effective communication, executive reporting, governance forums, and proactive escalation management in complex, global environments.
• Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by tracking and showcasing program metrics that prove the business value, sprint velocity gains, and adoption rates of deployed Salesforce capabilities to client leadership
• Quality Governance & Delivery Excellence: Establish and enforce delivery governance, standards, and best practices, ensuring compliance, quality benchmarks, and continuous improvement across projects.
• Champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants, and automated tracking to optimize implementation schedules and boost team development capacity
• Resource & Budget Management: Plan and optimise project resourcing, manage budgets and forecasts, track financials, and mitigate delivery and financial risks throughout the engagement.
• AI-Driven Productivity Enhancement: Encourage the strategic adoption of authorised AI technologies to boost team efficiency and optimise overall project delivery cycles.
• Timezone flexibility: Timezone flexibility to ensure comprehensive support and alignment with global customer needs.

Requirements:

Must Have
• 10+ years of total experience in the IT industry, with 5+ years delivering Salesforce projects.
• Proven experience managing Salesforce implementations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and/or Industry clouds.
• Strong understanding of the Salesforce delivery lifecycle, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Architects and Technical Leads (hands-on configuration is not required).
• Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and assertively with senior stakeholders and executives.
• Salesforce Certifications (any one): Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, or Experience Cloud Consultant.
• Project / Agile Management Certification (any one): PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Agilist, PRINCE2, CSM, or PSM.
• Hands-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), MS Project, Smartsheets, Google Workspace.
• Awareness and practical exposure to AI-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Gemini, Notebook LM, Claude) and an Agentic Delivery mindset.
• Willingness to travel on a need basis.

Desirable/Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering Salesforce projects in Financial Services, Consumer Goods, Healthcare, or Life Sciences domain(s).
  • Exposure to MuleSoft, Salesforce Data Cloud, or related integration and data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Agentforce use cases or related Specialist certifications, with a foundational understanding of how to scope, track, and manage digital agent-enabled projects.

Position/Role: HCC Medical Coder

Job Summary

As a HCC Medical Coder, you will be responsible for accurately assigning ICD-10 and CPT codes to medical diagnoses and procedures by reviewing outpatient and inpatient medical records. You will ensure compliance with customer and regulatory guidelines while maintaining a coding accuracy of 97% or higher within the defined turnaround time. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of US healthcare coding standards.

About Company

TECH-INTELLEON Digital Solutions is an AI-first, cloud-native technology partner building secure, scalable, and automation-led digital products for global clients. We combine enterprise-grade delivery with modern engineering, AI/ML, cloud, DevOps, and intelligent automation to move clients from idea to impactfast.

Our enterprise-grade delivery backbone is strengthened by HIPAA, ISO 27001, and ISO 9001 certifications, embedding trust, resilience, and compliance by design. We enable our clients' digital transformation through integrated IT services and talent solutions. With the launch of Medical Coding Services, we further extend our healthcare capabilities across both digital and operational value chains.

Recognized with the Best Innovative Project of the Year 2025, we continue to set benchmarks in applied innovation. A high-performance team of experienced leaders and next-generation talent, we push technology beyond convention to create real impact.

TECH-INTELLEON is not just a jobit's a platform to turn ideas into outcomes and ambition into influence. If you thrive on ownership and innovation, this is where your work truly matters.

Responsibilities

  • Research and resolve complex or unusual coding scenarios using appropriate coding resources and industry references.
  • Participate in coding quality reviews, training sessions, and team meetings to stay updated with the latest coding guidelines and industry changes.

Qualifications and Required Skills

jobDescription:
Telecaller Franchise Acquisition / Telesales

Job Title: Telecaller – Franchise Acquisition
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 0–3 years
Location: Nirman Vihar, Delhi
Salary: No bar for the deserving candidate

Reports To: Franchise Sales Manager / Business Development Manager

About the Role

We are looking for an energetic, confident, and target-oriented Telecaller – Franchise Acquisition to support the expansion of our franchise network.

The successful candidate will connect with prospective franchise partners, understand their business interests and investment capacity, explain the franchise opportunity, qualify leads, manage follow-ups, and schedule meetings with the Franchise Sales or Business Development team.

This role is suitable for freshers and professionals with experience in telecalling, telesales, real estate, business development, education sales, financial products, or franchise acquisition. The position combines lead generation, consultative communication, CRM management, and appointment setting—core activities commonly associated with telecalling and franchise-sales roles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make outbound calls to prospective franchise investors, entrepreneurs, business owners, and assigned leads.
  • Introduce the company, brand proposition, franchise model, products or services, and expansion opportunity.
  • Understand the prospect’s location preference, business interests, investment budget, experience, and expected timeline.
  • Qualify prospects based on predefined criteria such as investment capacity, preferred territory, business background, and readiness to proceed.
  • Explain approved information regarding franchise fees, setup requirements, support services, infrastructure, onboarding process, and next steps.
  • Handle basic queries and objections professionally, escalating commercial, legal, financial, or operational questions to the relevant team.
  • Conduct systematic follow-ups through calls, WhatsApp, email, and other approved communication channels.
  • Share brochures, presentations, application forms, Expression of Interest forms, or other approved franchise information.
  • Schedule qualified meetings, video calls, office visits, discovery sessions, and discussions with the Franchise Sales or Business Development team.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records of calls, conversations, lead status, follow-up dates, requirements, and outcomes in the CRM or lead-management system.
  • Coordinate with the team to ensure timely movement of prospects through the franchise acquisition funnel.
  • Track pending follow-ups and ensure that no qualified lead is neglected.
  • Collect relevant prospect information and share qualified leads with the concerned Manager or department.
  • Provide regular updates on lead quality, prospect feedback, objections, and market response.
  • Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets related to calls, meaningful conversations, qualified leads, appointments, and conversions.
  • Follow company-approved communication scripts, data-protection practices, calling guidelines, and franchise-disclosure policies.

Lead Qualification Parameters

The candidate will be expected to assess:

  • Preferred city, territory, or location.
  • Available investment range and funding readiness.
  • Relevant business or industry experience.
  • Interest in operating the business directly or appointing a manager.
  • Expected launch timeline.
  • Understanding of the franchise model.
  • Key questions, concerns, and decision-making factors.
  • Availability for a detailed discussion with the Franchise Sales team.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a candidate who is:

  • Excellent in verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Confident and comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
  • Persuasive, enthusiastic, patient, and results-oriented.
  • Capable of building rapport with business owners and potential investors.
  • Good at identifying customer needs and handling basic objections.
  • Comfortable working with sales targets, performance metrics, and incentives.
  • Organized and consistent with follow-ups.
  • Able to record information accurately in CRM or lead-management systems.
  • Comfortable using MS Office, WhatsApp, email, Google Sheets, and basic CRM tools.
  • Fluent in Hindi and English; knowledge of regional languages will be an advantage.
  • Professional, ethical, and careful while communicating commercial or investment-related information.

Educational Qualification and Experience

  • Minimum qualification: graduation in any discipline; experienced one in same domain will be preferred.
  • Freshers with strong communication, persuasion, and customer-handling skills may apply.
  • Preferred experience: 1–3 years in telecalling, telesales, franchise sales, real estate, education sales, insurance, banking, business development, or lead generation.
  • Experience in CRM-based calling, appointment setting, or B2B/B2C sales will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be evaluated through a balanced combination of activity, quality, and conversion metrics:

  • Number of outbound calls made.
  • Meaningful conversations completed.
  • Qualified franchise leads generated.
  • Lead qualification accuracy.
  • Follow-up completion rate.
  • Meetings or appointments scheduled.
  • Lead-to-meeting conversion rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion.
  • Franchise acquisition or sales contribution.
  • CRM data accuracy and timely updates.
  • Monthly and quarterly target achievement.

What We Offer

  • Fixed salary plus performance-based incentives.
  • Attractive earning potential linked to measurable performance.
  • Structured training on the company, franchise model, products, and sales process.
  • Calling scripts, lead-management support, and sales enablement resources.
  • Opportunity to work with the Franchise Sales and Business Development team.
  • Career growth opportunities in telesales, franchise sales, business development, and relationship management.
  • Recognition and rewards for high-performing employees.
  • Positive, professional, and performance-driven work environment.

Why Join Us?

Join a growing organization where your communication and sales skills can directly contribute to business expansion. This role offers practical experience in franchise acquisition, lead qualification, relationship management, telesales, and business development.

If you enjoy speaking with people, identifying business opportunities, and working toward sales targets, apply now and build your career in franchise sales and business development.

title: Medical Transcriptionist - Radiology
tagsAndSkills: Radiology Medical Transcription,Radiology Terminology,Medical Transcription,Radiology Reports,Report Transcription,MRI Reports,Medical Writing,Clinical Documentation
jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities:-

  • Accurately transcribe radiology reports dictated by Radiologists for X-Ray, CT, MRI, Ultrasound, Doppler, Mammography, PET-CT and other imaging modalities as applicable.
  • Accurately capture clinical history, examination details, findings, measurements, observations, impressions and recommendations dictated by the Radiologist.
  • Proofread and review reports for medical terminology, spelling, grammar, punctuation, numerical values, measurements and formatting accuracy.
  • Verify patient identifiers such as Patient Name, UHID/MRN, examination details, accession/study number and date of examination before processing the report.
  • Ensure that reports are correctly linked to the appropriate patient and investigation.
  • Identify unclear, incomplete or inaudible dictation and obtain clarification from the concerned Radiologist.
  • Ensure transcription is completed within the defined Radiology Department Turnaround Time (TAT).
  • Prioritize urgent/stat, emergency and other priority reports according to hospital protocol.
  • Process and route reports through HIS/HIMS, RIS, PACS, EMR or other approved systems.
  • Ensure reports are submitted to the authorized Radiologist for verification/finalization as per hospital workflow.
  • Make corrections or amendments only as authorized and in accordance with the hospital's approved reporting process.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and security of patient information and medical records.
  • Follow hospital policies, departmental SOPs, quality procedures, information-security requirements and applicable NABH standards.
  • Report patient-identification discrepancies, documentation errors, system issues and other quality-related concerns to the appropriate authority.
  • Maintain records related to pending reports, corrections, TAT, and quality monitoring as required.
  • Participate in internal quality audits, competency assessments, training programs and NABH-related assessments when required.
  • Coordinate effectively with Radiologists, Radiology technicians, Medical Records, IT, Quality and other concerned departments.
  • Follow approved downtime procedures in case of HIS/RIS/PACS or other system unavailability.
  • Perform other duties related to radiology documentation and medical transcription as assigned by the Radiology HOD/authorized supervisor.

Preferred candidate profile:-


Required Skills:-

  • Strong knowledge of medical and radiology terminology.
  • Excellent English grammar, spelling, punctuation and proofreading skills.
  • Good listening and comprehension ability.
  • High typing speed with excellent accuracy.
  • Knowledge of Radiology reporting terminology and formats.
  • Familiarity with HIS/HIMS, RIS, PACS, EMR/EHR and medical transcription software.
  • Good computer skills, including MS Office.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to meet strict TAT and productivity requirements.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and information security.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a hospital environment.

Educational Qualification:-

  • Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
  • Diploma/Certificate in Medical Transcription preferred.
  • Candidates with relevant experience in Radiology Medical Transcription will be preferred.

Experience:-

  • 2 - 7 years of experience in Medical Transcription, preferably in a hospital/diagnostic center.
  • Candidates with prior experience in Radiology report transcription will be given preference.
  • Experience in a NABH-accredited hospital is an added advantage.

jobDescription:
Asset Lifecycle & Lease Management Executive / Senior Executive Role


Overview


Executive / Senior Executive Asset Lifecycle & Lease Management will be responsible for supporting asset-related operational activities across the asset lifecycle.

The role involves maintaining accurate asset and contract records, processing customer requests, supporting end-of-lease activities, validating asset data, and ensuring timely resolution of queries while maintaining high standards of data quality, customer service, and operational compliance.


Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Manage and respond to asset-related requests received through functional mailboxes and internal workflow systems.
  • Maintain and update asset and contract information across systems, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Support end-of-lease activities including returns, extensions, purchase requests, and contract amendments.
  • Prepare, review, and validate asset data files for upload into internal systems and customer portals.
  • Verify asset details including quantities, serial numbers, statuses, and contractual information.
  • Monitor customer requests and ensure timely communication and resolution within agreed service levels.
  • Maintain accurate records of asset transactions and operational activities.
  • Support document retrieval and validation activities for customer requests, audits, and compliance requirements.
  • Review requests for new asset additions and ensure all required information is complete and accurate.
  • Maintain asset catalog data by updating records and identifying duplicate or incorrect entries.
  • Support process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.

Key Accountabilities


• Accuracy and completeness of asset and contract records.

• Timely processing of customer requests and operational transactions. • Adherence to service levels and turnaround times.

• Data quality and catalog maintenance standards.

• Customer satisfaction and effective stakeholder communication.

• Compliance with internal policies, procedures, and controls.


Essential Skills


• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Intermediate MS Excel skills.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Customer-focused mindset with strong organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.


Preferred Experience

• Experience in operations, asset management, leasing operations, financial services, banking, or related fields.

• Exposure to asset lifecycle management, lease administration, contract management, or customer operations.

• Experience working with operational data, customer requests, and process driven environments.

• Knowledge of equipment finance, leasing, or vendor finance processes will be an added advantage.


Educational Qualification


Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.


Working Conditions


• Shift aligned to business requirements (including international time zones).

• Fast-paced, customer-focused operational environment.

• Regular interaction with internal stakeholders and customers.

title: Clinical Coordinator  US Radiology Process

ambitionBoxData.Title: Advanced Telemed Services Reviews by Employees

jobDescription:
About Advanced Telemed

Advanced Telemed is a teleradiology company providing subspecialty radiology interpretation to hospitals, imaging centers, and emergency departments across the United States. Our radiologists read studies around the clock, and our operations team makes sure every result reaches the right clinician at the right time.


The Role

We are hiring a Clinical Coordinator with a nursing background to manage critical results communication between our radiologists and the ordering physicians at our US client facilities.

When one of our radiologists identifies a critical or urgent finding, you are the person who ensures it reaches the ordering physician quickly, accurately, and with a clean documentation trail. You will spend your shift on calls with US emergency physicians, hospitalists, and nursing supervisors coordinating, escalating, and documenting.

This is a clinical coordination role, not a bedside or clinical decision-making role. You will not assess patients, provide clinical advice, or exercise independent clinical judgment. You relay findings exactly as documented by the interpreting radiologist, and you connect the provider directly to that radiologist whenever a clinical question arises.

This role suits a nurse who wants to move out of hospital duty into a structured corporate role while still using their clinical knowledge every day.


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor the worklist for critical, urgent, and discrepant findings flagged by our radiologists
  • Call US ordering providers and facility staff to communicate findings as documented in the radiology report
  • Connect the interpreting radiologist directly to the ordering provider when clinical discussion is required
  • Document every communication attempt and completed contact per protocol, including time, method, and recipient
  • Escalate unreachable providers through defined facility escalation pathways until closure is confirmed
  • Track turnaround time and communication compliance against client service level agreements
  • Act as the operational point of contact for client facilities during your shift
  • Support quality audits of communication documentation and flag process gaps
  • Coordinate shift handover with the counterpart operations team

What This Role Does Not Involve

  • Bedside or hands-on patient care
  • Independent clinical assessment, triage, or medical advice
  • Interpretation of imaging studies
  • Sales, collections, or general customer service
  • Rotational shifts your schedule is fixed

Candidate Profile

Required

  • B.Sc Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc Nursing, or GNM with valid State Nursing Council registration
  • At least 2 years of clinical experience in Casualty / Emergency, ICU, or a comparable acute care unit
  • Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent you will speak with US physicians every shift
  • Confident phone presence: able to reach a busy physician mid-shift, deliver information concisely, and hold your ground when interrupted
  • Strong documentation discipline and comfort working within defined protocols
  • Willing to work the US night shift on a permanent basis

Preferred

  • Prior experience in a US healthcare process – clinical coordination, care management, utilization review, RCM with clinical exposure, or medical scribing
  • Familiarity with radiology workflow, PACS/RIS systems, or imaging terminology
  • Experience in an international voice process

What We Offer

  • Fixed hours – 9A-6P with 5 days onsite and one day working remotely
  • Structured training on US radiology workflow and critical results protocols
  • Career path into operations and quality leadership as the team grows

How To Apply

Applications that do not answer the question below will not be shortlisted. Please include your answer in your application message or at the top of your CV.


Advanced Telemed is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, caste, gender, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We never charge candidates any fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

jobDescription:

Senior Executive - Authorization


Job Description:


Responsible for end-to-end processing and follow-up of medical service authorization requests for US healthcare clients.

Process prior authorization and referral requests within defined TAT.

Submit authorizations through payer portals, online systems, fax, email and phone.

Review payer-specific authorization and referral requirements.

Track pending, approved, denied, cancelled and expired authorizations.

Follow up with payers and resolve authorization delays and denials.

Communicate authorization status and critical cases to clients.

Handle authorization tickets and participate in client calls.

Escalate complex cases requiring additional documentation, peer-to-peer or reconsideration.

Maintain accurate authorization records and work queues.

Support junior team members and assist with complex cases.

Prepare productivity, status and denial reports.

Identify process issues and contribute to workflow improvements.


Required Skills:


Strong knowledge of US healthcare insurance authorization and referral processes.

Good understanding of eligibility, benefits and payer requirements.

Knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10 and medical terminology preferred.

Experience with payer portals and healthcare RCM systems.

Strong communication, follow-up and analytical skills.

Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage high-volume work.

Ability to work independently and meet strict TAT and quality targets.


Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

4+ years of US Healthcare Medical Billing/RCM experience.

3+ years of hands-on Authorization experience preferred.


Keywords:

* 35 years of experience in US Healthcare RCM, Medical Billing, or Healthcare Operations.

* Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience in insurance authorization and referral management.

* Strong experience handling prior authorizations from submission through final determination.

* Experience working with US commercial, Medicare, Medicaid and preferably Workers Compensation payers.

* Strong knowledge of insurance eligibility, benefits, referral requirements and authorization requirements.

* Experience using payer portals, online authorization systems, fax, email and telephone-based authorization processes.

* Strong follow-up skills for pending, denied, partially approved and delayed authorizations.

* Experience handling complex, urgent and high-priority authorization cases.

* Strong communication skills with insurance representatives, clients and internal teams.

* Comfortable handling client tickets, emails, chats and participating in client calls.

* Strong documentation, tracking and work queue management skills.

* Ability to meet strict TAT, productivity and accuracy targets in a high-volume environment.

* Experience mentoring junior team members and supporting complex case resolution.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to denial prevention.

* Candidates with experience in Pain Management, Workers Compensation, DrChrono, Availity, Cohere or RadMD will be preferred.

jobDescription:

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Mobile Application Tester to ensure the quality, performance, and usability of mobile applications across Android and iOS platforms. The candidate will be responsible for manual and automation testing of mobile apps to deliver high-quality user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements and create test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for mobile applications
  • Perform manual testing on Android and iOS devices
  • Execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, UAT, and exploratory testing
  • Test mobile-specific features such as:
    • Push notifications
    • App installation/uninstallation
    • Device compatibility
    • Network conditions (2G/3G/4G/5G/Wi-Fi)
  • Validate UI/UX, gestures, screen resolutions, and orientations
  • Perform compatibility testing across devices, OS versions, and screen sizes
  • Log, track, and retest defects using tools like JIRA, Bugzilla, Azure DevOps
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and designers in Agile/Scrum teams
  • Perform API testing for mobile-backend communication
  • Validate app performance, stability, and battery usage

Required Skills

Mobile Testing Skills

  • Strong experience in Android and iOS application testing
  • Knowledge of mobile app life cycle
  • Understanding of mobile UX guidelines (Material Design, iOS HIG)
  • Experience with real devices and emulators/simulators

Tools & Technologies

  • Test management tools: JIRA, TestRail, ALM
  • API testing tools: Postman, Charles Proxy, Fiddler
  • Device cloud platforms: BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, Firebase Test Lab

Automation (Preferred)

  • Experience with Appium (Android & iOS)
  • Knowledge of:
    • Selenium + Appium
    • TestNG / JUnit / Cucumber
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Basic knowledge of Java / Python / JavaScript

Performance & Security (Nice to Have)

  • Mobile performance testing using JMeter, LoadRunner
  • Knowledge of mobile security testing (OWASP Mobile Top 10)
  • Experience testing offline/online sync scenarios

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and in teams
  • Attention to detail and quality mindset

Preferred Qualifications

  • ISTQB / Mobile Testing Certification (optional)
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Experience in banking, e-commerce, healthcare, or fintech mobile appsRole & responsibilities

title: Sr Statistical Programmer(ADaM & TLF)
jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities

Job Responsibilities

  • Uses SAS or other software to develop custom programming code to generate summary tables, data listings, graphs and derived datasets as specified in the statistical analysis plan and programming specifications.
  • Works to ensure that outputs meet quality standards and project requirements. Performs validation programming and works with other Programmers, Biostatisticians, and other project team members to resolve discrepancies or any findings. Keeps project team members informed of programming progress and issues requiring their attention. Follow applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, testing, and verification/quality control documents and programs ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects at a time, sets goals based on priorities from management, and adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload. Develops specifications for datasets and outputs of any complexity according to statistical and sponsor requirements. Anticipates and addresses potential programming issues, reflects forethought, establishes the basis for efficient programming and accurately defines all variables to be accepted by peer review and sponsor/requestor with little rework.
  • Prepares in advance for internal meetings, contributes ideas, and demonstrates respect for opinions of others.
  • Conducts effective internal meetings (appropriate in format, frequency and attendance). Distributes relevant information in advance. Ensures minutes are promptly and accurately distributed. Follows action items through to completion, and maintains order and focus of meetings, working toward consensus. Displays willingness to work with others and assist with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business. Negotiates and establishes accurate time estimates for completion of study programming activities with internal team members and statistical programming management, and completes project programming activities within timeframe allotted.
  • Acts as the lead statistical programmer. Directs the programming activities of other programming personnel and monitors progress on programming deliverables. Reviews project documentation such as Statistical Analysis Plan, mock shells, programming specifications, annotated CRFs, and SAS database design. Provides feedback to the appropriate project team members which reflects forethought and reduces inefficiencies in programming activities.
  • Participates in sponsor meetings, kickoff meetings, and bid defense meetings as statistical programming representative, as required by sponsor. Contributes to the mentoring of programming personnel through developing training courses, presenting training materials, reviewing work, and providing feedback or guiding new associates in process. Transfers deliverables. Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required.

ambitionBoxData.Title: Psa Chemicals Pharmaceuticals Reviews by Employees

jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION

OFFICER / EXECUTIVE QUALITY ASSURANCE (VENDOR QUALIFICATION)

Department: Quality Assurance – Corporate Quality Assurance
Position: Officer / Executive – QA (Vendor Qualification)
Reporting To: AGM – Corporate Quality Assurance
Location: Head Office
Number of Positions: 01
Industry: Pharmaceutical – Finished Formulations

1. JOB PURPOSE

To manage and coordinate the Vendor Qualification and Vendor Quality Management System for vendors/suppliers of APIs, excipients, packaging materials, contract service providers and other quality-critical materials/services, ensuring compliance with applicable GMP, regulatory requirements and company SOPs.

The incumbent will be responsible for vendor evaluation, qualification, documentation, periodic requalification, quality audits, CAPA follow-up and maintenance of approved vendor records.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Vendor Qualification & Evaluation

  • Coordinate the complete Vendor Qualification process from initial evaluation through approval and periodic requalification.
  • Review and evaluate vendor qualification documents, questionnaires and supporting records.
  • Coordinate collection and review of:
    • GMP certificates
    • Manufacturing/Business licenses
    • ISO certificates
    • Product specifications
    • COA formats
    • DMF/technical documents, wherever applicable
    • TSE/BSE declarations
    • Non-GMO declarations
    • Allergen/Gluten-free declarations
    • Nitrosamine statements
    • Elemental impurity declarations
    • Residual solvent declarations
    • Regulatory approvals/certificates
    • Quality manuals and other relevant quality documents.
  • Evaluate vendor compliance against approved qualification criteria and SOP requirements.
  • Prepare/review Vendor Qualification Reports (VQR) and recommend qualification status to the concerned authority.
  • Maintain and update the Approved Vendor List (AVL) under the direction of CQA.

B. Vendor Audit Management

  • Coordinate on-site, remote and desktop vendor audits as per approved audit plans.
  • Prepare audit schedules, agendas and audit-related documentation.
  • Participate in vendor audits as a QA representative, wherever required.
  • Prepare/coordinate audit reports and communicate observations to vendors.
  • Follow up with vendors for timely submission of CAPA plans and supporting evidence.
  • Review CAPA responses for adequacy and effectiveness under the guidance of AGM – CQA.
  • Maintain vendor audit records and track closure of audit observations.

C. Vendor Requalification & Periodic Review

  • Monitor vendor qualification validity and initiate periodic vendor requalification within defined timelines.
  • Conduct periodic review of vendor performance, quality history and regulatory status.
  • Review complaints, deviations, rejected batches, OOS/OOT trends and other quality-related issues associated with vendors.
  • Recommend continuation, requalification, suspension or disqualification of vendors based on documented evaluation and Management/CQA decision.
  • Maintain vendor requalification trackers and ensure timely completion.

D. Quality Agreements

  • Coordinate preparation, review and execution of Quality/Technical Agreements with qualified vendors, where applicable.
  • Ensure quality responsibilities, change notification requirements, deviation handling, complaint management, documentation and regulatory responsibilities are appropriately defined.
  • Maintain records of executed Quality Agreements and monitor their validity/review status.

E. Vendor Performance Monitoring

  • Coordinate periodic assessment of vendor performance based on defined quality parameters.
  • Monitor:
    • Material quality
    • COA compliance
    • Rejection/retest trends
    • Complaints
    • OOS/OOT, where applicable
    • Deviations
    • Delivery/quality performance
    • Change notifications
    • Audit observations
    • Regulatory/GMP status.
  • Prepare vendor performance evaluation reports and escalate significant concerns to AGM – CQA.

F. Change Control & Regulatory/GMP Monitoring

  • Review vendor change notifications and coordinate assessment of their impact on product/material quality.
  • Maintain records of changes notified by vendors.
  • Coordinate with QA, QC, Regulatory Affairs, Purchase and other concerned departments for appropriate evaluation and implementation.
  • Monitor expiry/validity of critical vendor certificates and regulatory documents.
  • Escalate significant GMP/regulatory changes or compliance concerns to AGM – CQA.

G. Documentation & Data Management

  • Maintain complete and controlled Vendor Qualification Files (VQF).
  • Maintain electronic and physical records of vendor-related documents.
  • Maintain trackers for:
    • New vendor qualification
    • Vendor requalification
    • Vendor audits
    • CAPA closure
    • Quality Agreements
    • Certificate validity
    • Vendor performance
    • Change notifications.
  • Ensure documents are properly indexed, traceable and readily retrievable during audits/inspections.
  • Prepare periodic MIS reports for Management/CQA.

3. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION

Coordinate with:

  • Purchase / Procurement
  • QA / QC
  • Production
  • Warehouse
  • Regulatory Affairs
  • R&D / Technical
  • Supply Chain
  • Approved vendors and service providers
  • External auditors/consultants, wherever applicable.

The incumbent shall ensure that vendor-related quality activities are completed within approved timelines and in accordance with applicable procedures.

4. REGULATORY & GMP RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure Vendor Qualification activities comply with applicable GMP requirements, regulatory expectations and company SOPs.
  • Support preparation of vendor-related documentation for customer audits, regulatory inspections and internal audits.
  • Assist in responding to audit/inspection observations related to vendor qualification and supplier management.
  • Keep updated with applicable GMP expectations related to supplier qualification and quality risk management.

5. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

Essential:

  • B.Pharm / M.Pharm / Pharm.D or equivalent pharmaceutical qualification.

Preferred:

  • M.Pharm / PG Diploma in Quality Assurance / Regulatory Affairs or equivalent.

6. EXPERIENCE

Officer: Minimum 2–3 years relevant experience in Pharmaceutical QA, Vendor Qualification, Supplier Quality or Quality Systems.

Executive: Minimum 3–5 years relevant experience in Pharmaceutical QA, Vendor Qualification, Supplier Quality or Quality Systems.

Experience in API, excipient, Packaging material and Testing service-provider qualification will be preferred.

7. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Good knowledge of pharmaceutical GMP and Quality Management Systems.
  • Practical knowledge of Vendor Qualification and Supplier Quality Management.
  • Knowledge of vendor audits and CAPA evaluation.
  • Understanding of Quality Agreements and change notification requirements.
  • Good documentation and report-writing skills.
  • Working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Good analytical and evaluation skills.
  • Strong follow-up and coordination capability.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to review technical and quality documents critically.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

8. DESIRABLE KNOWLEDGE

Knowledge/exposure to:

  • WHO-GMP
  • EU-GMP
  • ICH Guidelines
  • ICH Q9 – Quality Risk Management
  • ICH Q10 – Pharmaceutical Quality System
  • Supplier/Vendor Quality Management
  • GDP principles
  • Data Integrity
  • Audit management
  • CAPA
  • Change Control
  • Deviation Management
  • OOS/OOT
  • Pharmaceutical Quality Risk Assessment.

9. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Timely completion of new vendor qualification.
  • Timely completion of periodic vendor requalification.
  • Timely closure of vendor audit observations/CAPA.
  • Accuracy and completeness of Vendor Qualification Files.
  • Timely execution and renewal of Quality Agreements.
  • Timely review of vendor change notifications.
  • Effective vendor performance monitoring.
  • Compliance with applicable SOPs and GMP requirements.
  • Audit/inspection readiness of vendor qualification documentation.

10. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong quality mindset and professional integrity.
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills.
  • Good communication and vendor coordination abilities.
  • Strong follow-up and ownership.
  • Analytical approach with attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and meet defined timelines.
  • Willingness to travel for vendor audits, where required.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of company and vendor information.

11. AUTHORITY & ESCALATION

The incumbent shall perform Vendor Qualification activities within the authority delegated by the AGM – Corporate Quality Assurance.

The employee shall not independently approve, suspend, disqualify or reinstate a vendor unless such authority is formally delegated. Significant quality, GMP, regulatory or compliance concerns shall be immediately escalated to the AGM – CQA.

12. GENERAL

The above responsibilities are indicative and not exhaustive. Management may assign additional responsibilities related to Corporate Quality Assurance, Vendor Qualification, Supplier Quality Management, Quality Systems, audits and GMP compliance based on organizational requirements.

The employee shall comply with all applicable company policies, SOPs, GMP requirements, quality systems and instructions issued by Management

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position: Officer Administration, Accounts & Data Entry

Department: Administration / Finance & Accounts
Designation: Admin Officer – Accounts & Data Entry
Reporting To: AGM – Corporate Quality Assurance & Head Office Operations / Designee & Management
Location: Head Office
Employment Type: Full-Time

1. JOB PURPOSE

To support day-to-day office administration, accounts-related data entry, documentation, record maintenance and coordination activities, ensuring accuracy, timely completion and proper maintenance of confidential company records.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Accounts & Data Entry

  • Enter and maintain accounting, purchase, sales, expense and other financial data in Tally/ERP/Accounting Software and MS Excel.
  • Prepare and maintain payment, receipt, expense and other accounting-related records.
  • Assist in preparation and checking of invoices, vouchers, debit/credit notes and supporting documents.
  • Verify data entered against source documents and ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain petty cash records and assist in routine cash/expense reconciliation.
  • Assist Accounts team in preparation of statements, schedules and MIS reports.
  • Maintain vendor/customer master data and update records as authorized.
  • Assist in reconciliation of invoices, payments and outstanding balances.
  • Scan, file and maintain soft copies and physical records of accounting documents.

B. Administration

  • Handle routine office administration and documentation activities.
  • Maintain office files, registers, records and correspondence.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, vendors, service providers and other external parties for routine administrative matters.
  • Assist in office stationery, consumables and other administrative requirements.
  • Maintain records of office expenses, bills, quotations and service-related documents.
  • Support travel, courier, dispatch and other office coordination activities.
  • Assist in maintaining employee-related administrative records, wherever required.
  • Ensure proper filing and retrieval of documents.

C. MIS & Reporting

  • Prepare routine daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports as assigned.
  • Maintain Excel-based trackers, databases and registers.
  • Support management with accurate and timely data for decision-making.
  • Identify discrepancies in data/documents and report them to the concerned person.

D. Documentation & Compliance

  • Ensure proper documentation and traceability of records.
  • Maintain confidentiality of financial, commercial, employee and company information.
  • Follow applicable company SOPs, policies and administrative procedures.
  • Ensure documents are properly authorized before processing.
  • Support internal/external audits by providing required records and documents under supervision.

3. REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Good working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word and email communication.
  • Working knowledge of Tally/ERP/Accounting Software.
  • Good typing and data-entry skills with high accuracy.
  • Basic understanding of accounting principles, invoices, vouchers and reconciliations.
  • Good documentation and filing skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of company information.
  • Good coordination and communication skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple routine tasks within defined timelines.
  • Attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

4. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

Minimum: Any Graduate / B.Com preferred.

Candidates with qualifications such as B.Com, BBA, M.Com or equivalent with relevant experience may be considered.

5. EXPERIENCE

Preferred Experience: 2–4 years in Administration, Accounts Data Entry, Back Office, MIS or similar role.

Experience in pharmaceutical/manufacturing/healthcare companies will be an added advantage.

6. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Honest and trustworthy.
  • Systematic and organized approach to work.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good discipline and punctuality.
  • Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
  • Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with different departments.
  • Professional conduct and appropriate workplace etiquette.

7. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Accuracy of accounting and data entries.
  • Timely completion of assigned reports and documentation.
  • Accuracy and completeness of records.
  • Timely processing and filing of invoices/vouchers/documents.
  • Maintenance of updated administrative records.
  • Compliance with company procedures and reporting requirements.
  • Responsiveness and coordination with internal/external stakeholders.

8. AUTHORITY & LIMITATIONS

The position shall perform activities within the authority delegated by Management. The employee shall not independently approve payments, financial transactions, purchase commitments, accounting adjustments or confidential documents unless specifically authorized by Management.

9. CONFIDENTIALITY

The employee shall maintain strict confidentiality of all company information, including financial data, employee records, customer/vendor information, commercial information, passwords, documents and other confidential business information, and shall not disclose or share such information without proper authorization.

10. GENERAL

The above responsibilities are indicative and not exhaustive. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities related to Administration, Accounts, MIS, Documentation and Data Entry based on organizational requirements.
